text:
olivia: Quick sync — Q3 roadmap for Console observability. I sketched three possible priority bundles: (A) Dashboards + quick filters MVP, (B) Tracing UI + adaptive sampling controls, (C) Error analysis pipeline + retention tiering. Need to pick main & fallback. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
kevin: My gut: tracing UI is the heaviest infra lift, but it unlocks root-cause speed. sampling controls would reduce cost growth.
anya: Agree w/ @kevin. Also customers keep asking for long retention on traces but at 10x cost. We should consider tiered retention (30d free, 90d paid).
sam: Data take: dashboards MVP is cheap to ship and reduces paging noise. We can measure "time-to-action" delta quickly with telemetry.
jules: From design — dashboards MVP can be narrow: saved views + share link + column filters. Keeps scope small. Tracing UI needs new primitives (span grouping, waterfall zoom).
olivia: OK, tradeoffs: shipping dashboards first gives visible product momentum. Tracing first yields larger customer ROI for engineering orgs. Error analysis sits in middle — high value but requires ingestion pipeline changes.
kevin: Rough infra estimate (very rough): dashboards MVP = 2 engs x 6w, tracing UI + sampling = 3 engs x 10w + infra changes, error pipeline = 2 engs x 8w + ETL work.
anya: For launch criteria, propose: dashboards MVP = (1) saved views, (2) shareable link, (3) 90% query success under 2s for top-95%. Tracing UI = (1) top-down flamechart, (2) adjustable sampling policy, (3) end-to-end retention policy applied. Error analysis = (1) grouped errors UI, (2) cause link to traces, (3) customer-facing regression alerts.
sam: We should add measurable OKRs: eg "reduce median time-to-detect from console by 30% for target customers" and "<10% increase in infra cost per 1M events for dashboards feature".
jules: Customer asks to prioritize retention choices in UI — make them discoverable in settings + billing help copy.
olivia: Customer-driven asks: AcmeHealth wants 90d traces + canary tracing for deployments. FinBank wants programmatic access to dashboards and stricter PII scrubbing. Keep these in backlog, mark as potential blockers for private deployments.
kevin: We need a cost model for retention tiers. I'll run a simulation: input = qps, avg span size, compression factor. Quick snippet below for modeling: ```python
def monthly_cost(qps, avg_span_bytes, retention_days, storage_cost_per_gb):
    gb_per_month = qps * 86400 * retention_days * avg_span_bytes / (1024**3)
    return gb_per_month * storage_cost_per_gb
```
kevin: I'll share baseline numbers by EOD Monday.
anya: Ops concern: sampling controls must not lose critical signals. We should include a safeguard: sample-on-error override and a low-rate full-trace capture for sampled requests flagged by anomaly detectors.
infra-bot: deploybot: new branch created: feature/console-dashboards-mvp by @kevin — CI started.
olivia: Decision proposal: Prioritize Dashboards MVP as Q3 alpha (ship to beta customers), scope tracing UI as Q3-B (research + infra prep), error-analysis pipeline as Q4. Owners: dashboards = kevin/jules, tracing infra = nya, error pipeline = sam.
kevin: 👍 will scope tickets and drop Fe/BE estimates by Wed.
anya: I'll draft the tracing infra RFC this week with sampling safety controls and rollback plan.
sam: I'll draft OKR metrics and the retention cost model doc.
jules: I'll produce 2 UI flows for dashboards (compact & detailed) for review Thursday.
olivia: Great. Action items: kevin tickets, anya RFC, sam cost doc, jules mockups. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to lock Q3 plan. If any customer asks require higher priority, flag immediately. :rocket:
